title: HOA Fee Drift Status Queue
dataSources: Mortgage-rate snapshots (`mortgage:rate`), property-listing and Zestimate data (`property:listing`), HOA fees (`hoa:fee`), property-tax installments (`propertytax:installment`), home-buying milestones (`homebuying:milestone`).
app: Mortgage-rate watchers, Zestimate exports, HOA-fee logs, and property-tax installment trackers streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and personal checklists.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hoa:fee
| stats count as records by fee_status
| sort - records
description: Shows the current shape of the workflow behind hoa fee drift using status counts.
value: A status queue is a useful control panel for slow, paperwork-heavy property processes because it shows what is waiting and what is done.
implementation: Map upstream statuses into a small, stable set to keep the chart readable.
visualization: Bar chart of records by workflow status.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how work around hoa fee drift is spread across waiting and done states.
